void.$description: Deepest indigo. App background, dice canvas, voids of space.

parchment.$description: Warm light surface for printed-feeling overlays.

brass-50.$description: Off-white — Tailwind primary-50 (Nuxt UI scale). DESIGN §2 doesn't enumerate this stop; emitted as a named token so consumers aren't authoring hex literals in @theme blocks.

brass-100.$description: Cream — Tailwind primary-100 / Nuxt UI scale stop.

brass-light.$description: Brass highlight. Headings, focused brass on dark. Tailwind primary-200.

brass-300.$description: Tailwind primary-300 — interpolated between brass-light and brass.

brass-400.$description: Tailwind primary-400 — interpolated between brass-light and brass.

brass.$description: Primary brass. Borders, key UI. Tailwind primary-500.

brass-deep.$description: Aged brass. Hairline rules, secondary borders. Tailwind primary-600.

brass-shadow.$description: Brass shadow. Inset shadows, deep dividers. Tailwind primary-700.

brass-800.$description: Tailwind primary-800 — between brass-shadow and near-black.

brass-950.$description: Tailwind primary-950 — deepest brass before void.

primary.$description: Primary body text on dark surfaces.

crimson.$description: Danger fill. Crit failures, destructive actions.

crimson-bright.$description: Danger emphasis. Crit text and chip foreground.

bubble-author-bg.$description: Chat bubble background for messages authored by the local user. Warm-violet, ~12% lighter than surface.night so author messages register without leaving brand. Pair: text on this is parchment-default.

bubble-other-bg.$description: Chat bubble background for messages authored by other members. Cool-indigo, sits between surface.night and surface.void. Pair: text on this is parchment-soft.

system-fg.$description: Foreground for kind=system messages — desaturated mauve, low-contrast on surface.void. AA contrast 4.6:1 vs surface.void; below body-text contrast on purpose so system rows don't visually dominate chat.

whisper-accent.$description: Whisper accent — lavender highlight for whisper tab strip, bubble border, and the lock glyph. Distinct from brand brass so members can scan broadcast vs whisper at a glance.
